about.what: Each skill's profile as the mod's profile writer keeps it in $.store (key: profileKey over the SKILL.md, the model alias and PROFILE_VERSION; value: { name, at, profile }), for the skills of skill-catalog.json. Written by eval/profiles.ts.

en.what: Build voice AI agents with natural conversations, tools, and workflows using ElevenLabs.
en.use_when: Creating voice assistants, chatbots, customer service agents, configuring agent tools, procedures, or publishing agents.
en.not_for: Text-only chatbots without voice, non-conversational AI, or services not using ElevenLabs.

zh.what: 使用ElevenLabs构建具有自然对话、工具和工作流的语音AI代理。
zh.use_when: 创建语音助手、聊天机器人、客户服务代理、配置代理工具和程序或发布代理时。
zh.not_for: 不需要语音的纯文本聊天机器人、非对话型AI或不使用ElevenLabs的服务。

en.what: Review code changes against repo standards and spec requirements in parallel.
en.use_when: User wants to review a branch, PR, or changes since a commit, tag, or merge-base.
en.not_for: Linting or automated tooling; single-axis style checks; reviews without a fixed point.

zh.what: 按代码规范和需求规格并行审查代码变更。
zh.use_when: 用户要求审查分支、拉取请求或某个提交/标签以来的变更。
zh.not_for: 代码检查工具；单轴风格检查；无固定对比点的审查。

en.what: Provides vocabulary and principles for designing deep modules with small interfaces and hidden complexity.
en.use_when: User wants to design module interfaces, improve testability, find deepening opportunities, or decide where seams go.
en.not_for: Implementation details, specific language features, or architectural patterns beyond module-level design.

zh.what: 提供深模块设计的术语和原则，用小接口隐藏复杂实现逻辑。
zh.use_when: 用户需要设计模块接口、改进可测试性、找到深化机会或确定接缝位置。
zh.not_for: 实现细节、特定语言特性或超出模块级设计范围的架构模式。

en.what: Systematic diagnosis of hard bugs and performance regressions through tight feedback loops.
en.use_when: User reports something broken, failing, throwing errors, or running slow; asks to debug or diagnose.
en.not_for: Feature requests, code reviews, refactoring, or general how-to questions.

zh.what: 通过紧密反馈循环系统诊断疑难 bug 和性能回退。
zh.use_when: 用户报告代码崩溃、异常、失败或性能变慢；要求调试或诊断问题。
zh.not_for: 功能需求、代码审查、重构或通用技术问题。

en.what: Build and refine a project's domain model through active terminology work.
en.use_when: Discussing codebase terminology, creating or editing GLOSSARY.md, or writing ADRs.
en.not_for: Passively reading existing glossaries or implementing code features.

zh.what: 通过主动术语工作来构建和完善项目的领域模型。
zh.use_when: 讨论代码库术语、创建或编辑GLOSSARY.md、或编写ADR时使用。
zh.not_for: 被动阅读现有词汇表或实现代码功能。

en.what: Dub audio and video into other languages while preserving original speaker voices.
en.use_when: Translating videos, podcasts, or recordings into other languages; localizing media content; editing dubbing transcripts.
en.not_for: Transcription, subtitle generation, voice cloning, or general audio editing.

zh.what: 使用ElevenLabs API将音频和视频配音成其他语言，保留原始说话者的声音。
zh.use_when: 将视频、播客或录音翻译成其他语言；本地化媒体内容；编辑配音转录和翻译。
zh.not_for: 语音识别、字幕生成、声音克隆或常规音频编辑。

en.what: Automates browser tasks like navigating websites, filling forms, clicking buttons, and extracting data.
en.use_when: You need to open websites, interact with web apps, test web interfaces, or automate browser workflows.
en.not_for: Non-browser tasks like file processing, calculations, or API calls without a web interface.

zh.what: 自动化浏览器任务，如导航网站、填写表单、点击按钮和提取数据。
zh.use_when: 需要打开网站、与网络应用交互、测试网页界面或自动化浏览器工作流。
zh.not_for: 非浏览器任务，如文件处理、计算或无网页界面的API调用。

en.what: Set up Claude Code hooks to block dangerous git commands like push and reset.
en.use_when: User wants to prevent destructive git operations or add git safety guardrails to Claude Code.
en.not_for: General git workflow help, branch management, or reviewing git history.

zh.what: 设置Claude Code钩子以阻止危险的git命令（如push和reset）。
zh.use_when: 用户想防止破坏性git操作或为Claude Code添加git安全保护。
zh.not_for: 一般git工作流帮助、分支管理或git历史查看。

en.what: Systematically challenges plans, decisions, or ideas through relentless questioning.
en.use_when: User wants to stress-test thinking, validate decisions, or uses grill-related trigger phrases.
en.not_for: Providing advice, solutions, or information; casual brainstorming without critical scrutiny.

zh.what: 通过持续质疑来系统地挑战计划、决定或想法。
zh.use_when: 用户希望检验思路、验证决策或使用相关触发词语时。
zh.not_for: 提供建议、解决方案或信息；无批判性的头脑风暴。

en.what: Control Herdr terminal multiplexer to manage panes, tabs, workspaces, and coding agents.
en.use_when: User explicitly mentions Herdr or asks to inspect or control terminal layout and agents.
en.not_for: General background tasks, delegation, or parallel work without explicit Herdr mention.

zh.what: 控制Herdr终端多路复用器来管理窗格、标签、工作区和编码代理。
zh.use_when: 用户明确提及Herdr或要求检查或控制终端布局和代理。
zh.not_for: 没有明确提及Herdr的后台任务、委派或并行工作。

en.what: Converts a single image into a GLB 3D mesh using TRELLIS reconstruction.
en.use_when: User wants to turn an image into a 3D GLB mesh file or 3D model.
en.not_for: Batch image processing, multi-view 3D generation, OBJ export, or non-image inputs.

zh.what: 使用TRELLIS重建服务将单张图像转换为GLB 3D网格。
zh.use_when: 用户需要将图像转换为3D GLB网格文件或3D模型。
zh.not_for: 批量图像处理、多视图3D生成、OBJ导出或非图像输入。

en.what: Convert reference images into animation-ready procedural Three.js 3D models through staged sculpting.
en.use_when: You have an object or character image and need a code-built 3D model, reconstruction spec, or sculpt plan.
en.not_for: Photogrammetry, mesh extraction, downloading pre-made models, or converting existing 3D files.

zh.what: 通过分阶段雕刻流程将参考图像转换为动画就绪的Three.js程序化3D模型。
zh.use_when: 您有对象或角色图像，需要代码构建的3D模型、重建规范或雕刻计划。
zh.not_for: 摄影测量、网格提取、下载预制模型或转换现有3D文件。

en.what: Batch-sorts tens to thousands of text items into fixed categories with confidence scores.
en.use_when: You have text already in hand and need to classify, route, or rank it by closed options.
en.not_for: Single items, open-ended answers, or tasks requiring code execution or tool calls.

zh.what: 把几十到几千条文字分拣到固定答案里，输出带概率的结果。
zh.use_when: 已有文字在手，需要分类、路由或按概率排序。
zh.not_for: 单条项目、开放性问题、需要执行代码或调用工具的任务。

en.what: Runs browser experiments with fast TypeSafe Jev decisions replacing full LLM reasoning.
en.use_when: Automating browser tasks needing rapid, cost-efficient element selection and operation choices.
en.not_for: Login flows, CAPTCHAs, or tasks requiring full LLM reasoning over page snapshots.

zh.what: 使用TypeSafe Jev快速决策运行浏览器实验，替代完整LLM推理。
zh.use_when: 自动化浏览器任务，需要快速、低成本的元素选择和操作决策。
zh.not_for: 登录流程、验证码或需要完整LLM页面推理的任务。

en.what: Migrate test files from `as` type assertions to @total-typescript/shoehorn.
en.use_when: User mentions shoehorn, wants to replace `as` in tests, or needs partial test data.
en.not_for: Production code, runtime assertions, or non-test files.

zh.what: 将测试文件中的 `as` 类型断言迁移到 @total-typescript/shoehorn。
zh.use_when: 用户提到 shoehorn、想替换测试中的 `as` 或需要部分测试数据。
zh.not_for: 生产代码、运行时断言或非测试文件。

en.what: Build, test, run, and debug iOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps.
en.use_when: Building, testing, running, debugging, or automating Apple platform mobile and desktop applications.
en.not_for: Android development, web apps, or general purpose command-line tasks.

zh.what: 构建、测试、运行和调试 iOS、macOS、watchOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用。
zh.use_when: 需要构建、测试、运行、调试或自动化 Apple 平台的移动和桌面应用时。

en.what: Generate music from text prompts using ElevenLabs API.
en.use_when: Creating instrumental tracks, songs with lyrics, background music, jingles, or any AI-generated music composition.

en.use_when: User needs to create, modify, or iteratively refine reference images with AI.

zh.not_for: 图像处理、超分、抠图等非参考图的任务。

en.what: Build throwaway prototypes to validate design questions about logic, state models, or UI.

en.use_when: User wants research done, documentation gathered, or API facts verified from official sources.
en.not_for: Quick answers, summaries of existing write-ups, or tasks not requiring primary source verification.

zh.what: 针对主要信息源进行调查研究，并将结果写入Markdown文件。

en.what: Creates exercise directory structures with problems, solutions, and explainers passing linting.

en.use_when: User needs to set up ElevenLabs API key or an API request fails due to missing key.

zh.use_when: 用户需要设置 ElevenLabs API 密钥或 API 请求因缺少密钥而失败时。

en.what: Set up Husky pre-commit hooks with lint-staged, Prettier, type checking, and tests.

zh.what: 配置 Husky 预提交钩子，集成 lint-staged、Prettier、类型检查和测试。

en.use_when: Creating sound effects, ambient sounds, UI sounds, cinematic impacts, or audio textures from text prompts.

en.use_when: Converting audio/video to text, generating subtitles, transcribing meetings, identifying speakers.

zh.use_when: 转换音频或视频为文本、生成字幕、转录会议、识别说话者。

en.what: Guide test-driven development using red-green-refactor cycles with public interface testing.

zh.what: 将音频录音中的声音转换为不同的目标声音，同时保留情感和时序。

zh.use_when: 为项目启动文档或设置代码库参考时。
zh.not_for: 更新现有文档或分析代码结构。

en.what: Reviews pending changes on the current branch for security vulnerabilities and risks.
en.use_when: You need to audit code changes for security issues before merging or deploying.
en.not_for: General code review, performance analysis, or style checking.

zh.what: 审查当前分支的待处理更改中的安全漏洞和风险。
zh.use_when: 需要在合并或部署前审计代码更改的安全问题时使用。
zh.not_for: 通用代码审查、性能分析或代码风格检查。

en.what: Use the built-in browser pane in Claude desktop app to browse websites.
en.use_when: You need to read pages, interact with sites, or sign in using Claude's own browser.
en.not_for: Claude in Chrome, localhost servers, or file:// URLs.

zh.what: 使用 Claude 桌面应用内置浏览器面板浏览网站。
zh.use_when: 需要阅读网页、与网站交互或使用 Claude 内置浏览器登录。
zh.not_for: Chrome 中的 Claude、本地服务器或 file:// URL。

en.what: Control your computer desktop: take screenshots, click, type, and scroll in native apps.
en.use_when: You need to interact with desktop applications like Notes, Finder, Settings, or control your screen.
en.not_for: Web browsing, which uses browser tools instead; financial transactions, which require your approval.

zh.what: 控制你的电脑桌面：截图、点击、输入和滚动本地应用。
zh.use_when: 你需要与桌面应用交互，如备忘录、访达、系统设置或控制屏幕。
zh.not_for: 网页浏览使用浏览器工具；金融交易需要你的明确批准。

en.what: Coordinates research across multiple sources and synthesizes findings into comprehensive reports.
en.use_when: You need to research a topic broadly, compare alternatives, analyze trends, or review literature across multiple sources.
en.not_for: Simple factual lookups, single-source queries, or tasks that don't require synthesis of multiple perspectives.

zh.what: 协调多源研究并将发现综合为全面报告。
zh.use_when: 需要广泛研究某个话题、比较多个选项、分析趋势或综合多个信息源的文献。
zh.not_for: 简单事实查询、单一信息源查询或无需综合多个观点的任务。

en.what: Create, edit, and format Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides files in Drive.
en.use_when: User wants to make, change, or format a Google file, or provides a docs.google.com link to edit.
en.not_for: Read-only questions about Google files, or Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files.

zh.what: 在 Google 云端硬盘中创建、编辑和格式化 Google 文档、表格和幻灯片。
zh.use_when: 用户想要创建、修改或格式化 Google 文件，或提供 docs.google.com 链接进行编辑。
zh.not_for: 关于 Google 文件的只读问题，或 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 和 PDF 文件。

en.what: Render a styled morning brief showing your day's shape and important items.
en.use_when: You explicitly ask to run, see, or set up your morning brief, or invoke /morning.
en.not_for: General questions about your day, schedule, or calendar. Answer those directly instead.

zh.what: 生成风格化的晨间简报,展示你的日程形状和重要事项。
zh.use_when: 你明确要求查看、运行或设置晨间简报,或直接调用 /morning。
zh.not_for: 关于你日程、日历或每日安排的一般问题。应直接回答而非使用此技能。

en.what: Learns your writing voice from your sent messages and docs, builds a profile for authentic drafts.
en.use_when: You want to set up your writing voice, capture your style, or make drafts sound like you.
en.not_for: Writing as Claude or other personas; analyzing others' writing; existing voice profiles.

zh.what: 从你发送的消息和文档中学习写作风格，建立档案使草稿听起来像你。
zh.use_when: 你想建立写作风格、捕捉个人风格或让草稿听起来更像你自己。
zh.not_for: 以Claude或其他人物身份写作；分析他人文章；已有风格档案的情况。

en.what: Create, edit, and evaluate skills using test cases and performance benchmarks.
en.use_when: User wants to build a new skill, modify an existing skill, run evaluations, or optimize skill triggering.
en.not_for: Using an existing skill for its intended purpose; general coding or writing tasks unrelated to skill creation.

zh.what: 创建、编辑和评估技能，包括测试用例和性能基准测试。
zh.use_when: 用户想要构建新技能、修改现有技能、运行评估或优化技能触发准确性。
zh.not_for: 使用现有技能实现其预期功能；与技能创建无关的通用编码或写作任务。

en.what: Route to the right skill or flow for your situation.
en.use_when: You are unsure which skill fits your work or how to navigate the skill map.
en.not_for: Executing a specific skill; use the skill directly once you know which one.

zh.what: 根据你的情况路由到正确的技能或流程。
zh.use_when: 你不确定哪个技能适合你的工作，或不知道如何在技能地图中导航。
zh.not_for: 执行具体的技能；一旦确定了技能，直接使用该技能。

en.what: Conducts a rigorous interview to refine and stress-test your plan or design.
en.use_when: You want critical feedback to strengthen a proposal, strategy, or concept before finalizing it.
en.not_for: Generating new ideas, implementation guidance, or detailed technical specifications.

zh.what: 通过严格的追问来打磨和验证你的计划或设计。
zh.use_when: 需要在定稿前获得尖锐的批评反馈，以完善方案、战略或概念。
zh.not_for: 创意生成、执行指导或详细的技术规范。

en.what: Conducts intensive interviews to refine plans or designs while generating documentation.
en.use_when: You need to sharpen a concept, design, or strategy and create ADRs and glossaries.
en.not_for: Quick answers, implementation details, or code generation.

zh.what: 通过深入访谈来完善计划或设计，同时生成文档。
zh.use_when: 需要精化概念、设计或策略，并创建ADR和术语表。
zh.not_for: 快速答案、实现细节或代码生成。

en.what: Summarize conversation into a handoff document for the next agent.
en.use_when: Ending a session and need to pass context to another agent or session.
en.not_for: Creating project specs, plans, or saving work artifacts in the current workspace.

zh.what: 将当前对话总结为切换文档，供下一个代理继续使用。
zh.use_when: 结束会话需要将上下文传递给另一个代理或下一个会话时。
zh.not_for: 创建项目规范、计划或在当前工作区保存工作成果。

en.what: Implement work based on specifications or tickets using test-driven development.
en.use_when: You have a spec or tickets describing features to build and need implementation.
en.not_for: Code review, design decisions, or planning work that hasn't been specified yet.

zh.what: 根据规格说明或工单实现工作，使用测试驱动开发。
zh.use_when: 你有明确的规格说明或工单描述需要构建的功能。
zh.not_for: 代码审查、设计决策或尚未指定的工作规划。

en.what: Implement a specification and its associated tickets into code on an integration branch.
en.use_when: You have a spec with tickets describing implementation tasks and need to build it.
en.not_for: Creating specs, generating tickets, or code review without a pre-existing spec.

zh.what: 根据规格说明书及其关联工单实现代码到集成分支。
zh.use_when: 你有规格说明书和描述实现任务的工单，需要构建代码。
zh.not_for: 创建规格说明书、生成工单或无规格说明书的代码审查。

en.what: Scan codebases for architectural friction and propose refactors that deepen modules.
en.use_when: You want to improve testability and navigability by identifying shallow modules worth refactoring.
en.not_for: Writing new code, fixing bugs, or optimizing performance.

zh.what: 扫描代码库寻找架构问题，提议深化模块的重构方案。
zh.use_when: 想通过识别和重构浅层模块来改进可测试性和可导航性。
zh.not_for: 编写新代码、修复缺陷或性能优化。

en.what: Interview you about recurring life patterns and create workflow specifications.
en.use_when: You want to design a new workflow or explore loops worth automating.
en.not_for: Implementing workflows, running existing automations, or general advice.

zh.what: 通过提问帮助你识别生活中的循环模式，并生成工作流规范。
zh.use_when: 你想设计新工作流或探索值得自动化的生活循环。
zh.not_for: 执行工作流、运行现有自动化或提供一般建议。

en.what: Analyze a coding session and suggest improvements to the development environment.
en.use_when: After completing a coding task, to identify navigation, automation, standards, or tooling improvements.
en.not_for: Writing code, reviewing pull requests, or debugging runtime issues.

zh.what: 分析编程会话并建议改进开发环境的方案。
zh.use_when: 完成编码任务后，识别导航、自动化、标准或工具链的改进机会。
zh.not_for: 编写代码、审查拉取请求或调试运行时问题。

en.what: Configure a repository for engineering skills: issue tracker, triage labels, and domain docs.
en.use_when: Setting up a new repo for the first time before using other engineering skills.
en.not_for: Updating existing skill configurations or modifying individual issue tracking workflows.

zh.what: 为工程技能配置仓库：问题追踪器、分类标签和领域文档。
zh.use_when: 首次为仓库设置，在使用其他工程技能之前。
zh.not_for: 更新已有技能配置或修改单个问题追踪工作流。

en.what: Set up dependency-cruiser to enforce deep modules in a TypeScript monorepo.
en.use_when: You want to hide package internals in subfolders and allow imports only through entry points.
en.not_for: Designing layering rules between packages or refactoring existing package structures.

zh.what: 在 TypeScript 单体仓库中配置 dependency-cruiser 来强制深模块架构。
zh.use_when: 需要隐藏包的内部实现在子文件夹中，仅允许通过入口点导入。
zh.not_for: 设计包之间的分层规则或重构现有的包结构。

en.what: Teach you a new skill or concept through structured lessons and reference materials.
en.use_when: You want to learn a topic deeply over multiple sessions with guided lessons.
en.not_for: Quick answers to specific questions or one-off explanations of concepts.

zh.what: 通过结构化课程和参考资料教你新技能或概念。
zh.use_when: 你想在多个学习阶段深入学习一个话题，需要有指导的课程。
zh.not_for: 快速回答具体问题或一次性解释概念。

en.what: Create a structured questionnaire to gather missing knowledge from someone else.
en.use_when: You need specific information or decisions from another person to move forward.
en.not_for: Surveys, feedback forms, or questions for people without specialized knowledge you need.

zh.what: 创建结构化问卷，从他人处收集缺失的信息。
zh.use_when: 需要从另一个人那里获取特定信息或决策以继续推进工作。
zh.not_for: 调查问卷、反馈表单或向没有你需要的专业知识的人提问。

en.what: Synthesize current conversation into a spec and publish to issue tracker.
en.use_when: You have discussed a feature and need to formalize it as a specification.
en.not_for: Gathering new requirements, interviewing users, or exploring undefined ideas.

zh.what: 将当前对话合成规格说明并发布到问题跟踪器。
zh.use_when: 已讨论功能需求，需要将其正式化为规格说明文档。
zh.not_for: 收集新需求、采访用户或探索未定义的想法。

en.what: Break plans, specs, or conversations into vertical-slice tickets with blocking edges.
en.use_when: You need to decompose work into traceable, independently-demoable tasks with dependencies.
en.not_for: Estimating effort, assigning owners, or managing existing tickets.

zh.what: 将计划、规范或对话分解为包含阻塞关系的垂直切片工单。
zh.use_when: 需要将工作分解为可独立演示的任务并标明依赖关系时。
zh.not_for: 估算工作量、分配所有者或管理现有工单。

en.what: Move issues and PRs through triage states, categorize, verify claims, and write agent briefs.
en.use_when: You need to evaluate, categorize, or advance issues and external PRs through a triage workflow.
en.not_for: Implementing features, merging code, or closing issues without triage evaluation first.

zh.what: 将议题和PR通过分类状态机推进,验证并撰写代理简报。
zh.use_when: 需要评估、分类议题或外部PR,推进其通过分类工作流程。
zh.not_for: 实现功能、合并代码或直接关闭议题而不进行分类评估。

en.what: Asks for clarification and repitching of an unclear message using simplified language.
en.use_when: A previous message was confusing, unclear, or did not communicate effectively.
en.not_for: Understanding code, debugging, or technical problem-solving requests.

zh.what: 要求用简化语言重新阐述一条不清楚的消息。
zh.use_when: 前面的消息不清楚、难以理解或无效表达。
zh.not_for: 代码理解、调试或技术问题解决。

en.what: Plan large work efforts by charting decision tickets on an issue tracker.
en.use_when: Work is too big for one session and the path forward is unclear or foggy.
en.not_for: Executing work, building deliverables, or resolving decisions independently.

zh.what: 通过在问题追踪器上绘制决策工单来规划大型工作。
zh.use_when: 工作超出单个会话范围，前进方向不清楚或模糊不明。
zh.not_for: 执行工作、交付成果或独立解决决策。

en.what: Assemble raw material into a structured article journey, grounding concepts beat by beat.
en.use_when: You have raw notes or fragments and want to build a coherent piece with guided pacing.
en.not_for: Writing from scratch, editing existing polished work, or organizing reference material.

zh.what: 将原始素材逐步组织成文章，每个节拍前确保概念已扎根。
zh.use_when: 你有散乱的笔记或片段，需要引导式地构建连贯的文章。
zh.not_for: 从零开始写作、编辑已成型的作品、或整理参考资料。

en.what: Conduct unstructured interviews to mine raw writing fragments without organizing them.
en.use_when: User wants to explore ideas, gather raw material, or brainstorm before committing to structure.
en.not_for: Organizing fragments, outlining articles, or creating final structured drafts.

zh.what: 通过非结构化访谈采集原始写作素材片段，不进行组织整理。
zh.use_when: 用户想探索想法、收集原始素材或在定稿前进行头脑风暴。
zh.not_for: 组织片段、制作大纲或创作最终结构化的草稿。

en.what: Shapes raw material into a structured article, paragraph by paragraph.
en.use_when: You have unstructured notes, fragments, or transcripts to transform into a coherent written piece.
en.not_for: Editing existing polished articles or creating new content from scratch without source material.

zh.what: 将原始素材逐段塑造成结构化的文章。
zh.use_when: 你有零散笔记、片段或记录需要转化为连贯的成文作品。
zh.not_for: 修改已成稿的文章或从无到有创作新内容。
